title: Integrated transcriptomic and biochemical analysis of beta-ionone induced developmental toxicity in zebrafish embryos.
authors: Liu, Siyang; Huang, Yang; Teng, Yewen; Tao, Qianyu; Zhu, Chengli; He, Sisi; Xu, Jiaqi; Xie, Jiajun; Zhu, Fangxin; Luo, Youxi; Zhou, Weicheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究β-紫罗酮对斑马鱼胚胎的发育毒性，涉及AhR信号通路转录激活和分子对接，但核心是毒理学而非蛋白质-DNA互作机制建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: beta-ionone, a cyclic isoprenoid and structural analogue of beta-carotene's end ring, is ubiquitous in aquatic systems. However, the developmental impacts of beta-ionone on aquatic organisms remain largely unexplored. This study investigated the effects of beta-ionone exposure (0, 189, 945, and 1890 mug/L) on zebrafish (Danio rerio) embryonic development from 2 to 120 hours post-fertilization (hpf). Our results demonstrate that beta-ionone induces dose-dependent developmental toxicity characterized by reactive oxygen species (ROS) overproduction and increased apoptosis. Comprehensive transcriptomic analysis identified activation of the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) signaling pathway as the primary mechanistic basis for this toxicity. Molecular docking confirmed strong binding interactions between beta-ionone and AhR (DeltaG = -10 kcal/mol), suggesting direct receptor activation. Further validation demonstrated that beta-ionone activates transcription of AhR target genes while significantly enhancing Phase I and Phase II metabolic enzyme activities. Our findings suggest that the AhR signaling pathway may play a critical role in mediating beta-ionone-induced developmental toxicity in zebrafish. Given these effects, beta-ionone warrants classification as a potential environmental contaminant requiring further ecological risk assessment.
abstract_zh: β-紫罗兰酮（beta-ionone），一种环状异戊二烯类化合物，是β-胡萝卜素末端环的结构类似物，在水生系统中普遍存在。然而，β-紫罗兰酮对水生生物发育的影响在很大程度上仍未得到探索。本研究调查了β-紫罗兰酮暴露（0、189、945和1890 μg/L）对斑马鱼（Danio rerio）胚胎发育的影响，时间从受精后2小时至120小时（hpf）。我们的结果表明，β-紫罗兰酮诱导剂量依赖性发育毒性，其特征是活性氧（ROS）过度产生和细胞凋亡增加。全面的转录组分析确定芳烃受体（AhR）信号通路的激活是该毒性的主要机制基础。分子对接证实β-紫罗兰酮与AhR之间存在强结合相互作用（DeltaG = -10 kcal/mol），提示直接受体激活。进一步验证表明，β-紫罗兰酮激活AhR靶基因的转录，同时显著增强I相和II相代谢酶活性。我们的发现表明，AhR信号通路可能在介导β-紫罗兰酮诱导的斑马鱼发育毒性中发挥关键作用。鉴于这些效应，β-紫罗兰酮应被归类为潜在的环境污染物，需要进一步进行生态风险评估。
